text_block_list.text:
"‘Otherworld,’ ‘Holy Maiden,’ ‘Devotee’— 
Lately, my search history is quickly 
filling up with fantasy keywords."

I want to truly understand Red Desire's 
wish. Yet, its true nature remains 
shrouded in mystery—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, parallel worlds do exist.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There are indeed Umamusume who know they 
truly exist.

I was able to hear about it from Vodka 
before. If there are other Umamusume who 
know about the other world, I'd definitely 
love to hear their stories.

Lost in thought while walking through the 
academy grounds—

Enveloped in a mysterious mist in the 
blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. Quite the rare guest, aren't 
you...?

Before I knew it, Manhattan Cafe was 
standing there.

She is an Umamusume with a mystical aura 
who conquered long-distance races one 
after another—the Kikuka Sho, the Arima 
Kinen, and then the Tenno Sho (Spring).
Oh, my...! Trainer, you came as well...!

Startled, I look up to see a familiar face 
elegantly tipping a teacup.
choice_data_list: Desire? What are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I was relaxing and enjoying the 
café latte that Cafe-san brewed for me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe-san is someone who bestows deep 
knowledge upon me, wrapped in a warm 
silence."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed, a magnificent predecessor... and 
one who understands my depths.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is why I frequently join her for tea 
parties... rather, for our sacred rituals.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please take your time as well. ...This too 
may be a form of guidance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right. The 'Umamusume who 
knows of the other world's existence' that 
I mentioned before... I was referring to 
Cafe-san as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. You had something you wanted to 
confirm about the "Other World"... didn't 
you?

I give a brief explanation of what 
happened and turn to face Manhattan Cafe.
choice_data_list: Please tell me about this 'Other World'!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You're right...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Like Desire-san, all those who gather 
in this room... are chasing after 
something.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Be it an existence, a physical object, or 
something intangible... It differs from 
person to person... truly diverse.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: However, the key is... "fulfillment."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She harbors a wish... to feel truly 
"fulfilled" from the bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"To gain what is to be gained, and to be 
the self I ought to be."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"In order to cast my shadow even darker, 
far into the future—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Those who share such feelings gather 
right here."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... This place... Cafe-san's caffe 
latte gives me such immense peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I thought that alone would be enough, 
but... It seems my heart remained 
unfulfilled after all.

Having overcome harsh trials, Red Desire 
was about to reach the otherworld.

Was there always a strong desire... to 
"find fulfillment"— to satisfy herself 
from within?
choice_data_list:
If I achieve fulfillment, can I go to the 
"Otherworld"?

If I achieve fulfillment, will I be able 
to go to the "Otherworld"?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I have no proof, but...

"Still, I felt it might at least offer a 
clue when pondering 'how to reach an 
alternate world.'"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am certain of it. When your heart 
finds true fulfillment... a new door shall 
surely open...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So fulfillment is the key to 
reaching the 'Otherworld'...!?

"All the more reason we must explore how 
to truly satisfy Red Desire."

From that day on—the days of fulfilling 
Red Desire's wishes began!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "O lost people, have no fear."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“I shall now bestow the Saint's power upon 
you all—!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Desire! You're wonderful!" 
"Wooo-hooo!"

Filling in for the drama club as a saint, 
she was showered with wolf-whistles and 
cheers from the audience.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... this is...! A breathtaking 
marriage of carrot and mixed berries...! 
Simply exquisite—!

Between training sessions, we'd go taste 
some popular carrot sweets...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If you look into each other's eyes as if 
into mirrors, love will naturally reveal 
itself. Now, take each other's hands—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
""Let us reaffirm our vows of eternity to 
one another once more...!""
(Ding-dong...)

I traveled a bit further—and even helped 
reconcile a newlywed couple who were 
arguing on their honeymoon.

Red Desire seemed to enjoy herself no 
matter what she was experiencing. But—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... They were truly wonderful, precious 
days.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, warmth spreads deep in my chest...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The “joy of receiving”... is so deeply... 
warm and comforting...

Still, somehow I feel like that's not what 
Red Desire is looking for.

What she truly desires is something 
crimson, burning, and ablaze—
choice_data_list:
Shall we do a little training once we're 
back?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ! Yes, gladly!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —...Phew. Here goes one more run.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please time me one more time...!

I only intended for it to be a brief 
moment, but... Red Desire just wouldn't 
leave the track.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's keep at it until you're 
satisfied!

Yeah, let's keep going until you're 
completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer... Everything I've experienced so 
far has been filled with such warm light.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Only by dragging my bursting body forward 
and letting my heart blaze in the 
moment... does my soul truly ignite—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(This sensation... is the pure joy of 
overcoming trials. An irreplaceable 
feeling of truly being 'Saint Red 
Desire'——!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

"When I told her the time, a wide smile 
spread across her face."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Yes, this is the one...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To me, this is undeniable, pure 
fulfillment—!

The true nature of Red Desire's 
fulfillment. Watching her run with 
everything she has, I gradually started to 
realize it myself.
choice_data_list:
(Happiness that's just handed to you is 
meaningless.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
After all the hardships, surpassing one's 
limits... The victory grasped beyond that 
is truly what shines brightest—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To me, it is true "fulfillment"!

The path she should take is not some neat, 
pre-paved road walked while being led by 
the hand.

Let your guard down for even a moment, and 
the rug will be pulled from under you... 
It was only on the turf where she pushed 
herself to the limit, wearing down body 
and soul as she ran.
Then—there is only one thing to do.
choice_data_list:
Let's put together a plan for the next 
race!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, I would be delighted to!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue to run, overcoming harsh 
trials and single-mindedly pursuing the 
path of racing!

Having found a clue to bringing 
fulfillment to Red Desire... I felt as 
though I, too, had finally taken a step 
onto the path leading to the otherworld.
